arms: C-frozen-predictor (all predictor etas=0; stimuli frozen at init)
ablation_arms.purpose: Descriptive attribution of any C win (or loss) to its causal surfaces. Not gated; no verdict depends on them.

baselines.arch-A: Current arch-A, R1 default tick: WorkspaceTick(channels, neutral_specialists(channels, agent_seed), capacity=n_channels, gain_lr=0.15, theta=0.45, reward_baseline=0.5 fixed), CueIndexedArbitrator + context_fn where the env exposes a cue (changing_rule, compositional_rule, cue_delayed_reward), default arbitrator otherwise. A is NOT modified; the battery drives it through the same CAdapter env protocol.
baselines.arch-B: Intact ArchB: action_mode='active_inference', affect='none' (per NR-B-002 — error-affect is rejected; the world-model experiments' own config). B is NOT modified.

components.causal_surface: action selection flows through arbitration -> buffer -> ignition -> broadcast -> planner_input; R1 path on sub-ignition ticks. Same K2/K8-proven path as A.
components.integration: REUSED BY IMPORT (workspace_buffer, ignition, broadcast, consumers, tick modules). The C driver instantiates A's WorkspaceTick unchanged; predictor-driven specialists are passed as the specialists argument. No A code is modified.
components.source: A: WorkspaceTick skeleton — BoundedWorkspace (capacity K), RecurrentIgnition (theta=0.45), BroadcastBus sole-path with the 6 declared consumers, R1 sub-ignition exploratory path as default action selection

components.causal_surface: freeze-gains ablation (C-frozen-gains arm) removes the loop; K4/K10 are the parent evidence.
components.integration: REUSED BY IMPORT (attention, attention_cue). context_fn frozen per env (see config). The gain loop closes through the tick's feedback broadcast (utility={action: reward}), exactly as in A.
components.source: A: learned-gain attention loop (delta rule, lr=0.15, fixed reward_baseline=0.5, cap 2.0) + cue-indexed gain adapter (CueIndexedArbitrator) where the env exposes a cue

components.causal_surface: C-frozen-predictor arm (all etas=0) removes predictor learning; stimuli freeze at init values. K2 is the parent evidence.
components.integration: REUSED BY IMPORT (generative_model). Drives specialist stimuli: stimulus_a = rhat_a + kappa * mem_bonus_a, where rhat_a = predict_reward(mu0, a, ctx). Learning closes in the driver per tick: model.observe(state_vec, action, ctx, obs_next_vec, reward). The predictor is the ONLY stimulus source for C (no neutral-stimulus fallback).
components.source: B: HierarchicalGenerativeModel (L0 + context experts, estimated precision, B-default etas). Learned predictor core (K2 5/5).

components.causal_surface: C-no-memory arm (DisabledStore) removes the store; retrieval_correction honest-None path exercised. M1 is the parent evidence.
components.integration: REUSED BY IMPORT (memory). Per tick: memory.store(obs_vec, action, reward, e0, e1, pi0, attention=surprise, tick, episode, env_name) with attention = max(0, min(1, e0_abs/(1+ounc))) (B's formula). Retrieval feeds the specialist bonus: mem_bonus_a = predicted_error_for_action(obs_vec, a) or 0.0 when None.
components.source: B: EpisodicStore (attention-gated encoding, provenance, retrieval_correction, predicted_error_for_action). M1 CAUSAL, scope-bounded.

excluded_with_reasons: PAD affect: no genuine consumer exists in C (PAD's knobs modulate B's selector, which C does not use); wiring it to scale gain_lr would be decorative scaling with no preregistered causal surface. EXCLUDED.
error-derived affect: REJECTED (K4 — arousal saturates, permanent over-exploration). EXCLUDED.
ActiveInferenceSelector: the IG label machinery is killed (C4B); C's selection is A's arbitrator. EXCLUDED.
UsefulnessPredictor + RetrievalGate: uhat MISCALIBRATED on all 4 domains (EXP-FP-CALIB-01) and the sign-gate policy is degenerate (EXP-FP-0006). No calibrated decision surface exists. EXCLUDED.
H5 consolidation_cycle: offline replay showed no measured lift vs no-replay (EXP-FP-0005); no online causal surface in a per-tick loop. EXCLUDED.
c_assembly.name: Architecture C (hybrid)
seam_reimplementation: prototypes/architecture-c/c_agent.py: predictor-driven specialist factory + categorical-slice/context-key helpers (attributed copy of ArchB's 8-line helpers) + CAdapter (tick-protocol step(label)->reward plus driver-protocol last_transition/reset_episode) + the per-tick learning-close (model.observe + memory.store).
prototypes/architecture-c/experiments/run_battery.py: one driver loop for all three agents (identical env protocol, identical episode seeds).

Nothing else is reimplemented. A's tick.py, attention.py, attention_cue.py, ignition.py, broadcast.py, consumers.py, workspace_buffer.py, bids.py are imported unchanged. B's generative_model.py, memory.py, precision.py, shift_precision.py are imported unchanged.

charter: EXISTS ≠ INTEGRATED ≠ OPERATIONAL ≠ PROVEN; honest BLOCKED; never simulated evidence
doc_updates: prototypes/architecture-c/tests/test_arch_c.py (>=15 tests; gate suite must stay green)
episode_seeds: derive_seed(primary_seed, run_index, 'env') per episode (harness convention); agent stream derive_seed(primary_seed, 0, 'agent'). One env instance reused across episodes per run (phase dynamics advance); one agent instance reused across episodes (cross-episode learning). Same seeds for A, B, C, and ablation arms (paired).

frozen_config.stimulus: stimulus_a = rhat_a + kappa * mem_bonus_a (finite-guarded; arbitrator fail-closes on non-finite)

gates: G0a: fabrication tripwire CLEAN on prototypes/architecture-c/ before absorbing any result.
G0b: hash-chained receipts written per env (prereg -> per-seed records -> verdict); verify_chain passes on the C receipts dir.
G0c: determinism spot-check — one (env, seed, agent) rerun reproduces mean_return to 1e-9.
G0d: A and B baselines run on the SAME seeds through the SAME driver (paired).
G0e: no A or B source file modified (verify by mtime/hash note: A/B dirs untouched; C imports them).
hypothesis: H1: Architecture C (A's workspace machinery driven by B's learned predictor + B's episodic store) achieves higher mean episode return than current arch-A (R1 default) AND than intact arch-B, by the frozen per-env margins, on the fixed 5-env battery.
interpretation_rule: If C fails the margins, report the negative honestly with per-task per-seed breakdown and the ablation attribution. A clean negative is a first-class result. No post-hoc margin adjustment; no component swapping after seeing results.
limitations_preregistered: Single lab; no independent replication of C.
5 envs; pomaze/delayed_reward reward scales differ from bandit envs.
kappa=0.1 is a frozen design choice, not tuned.
C inherits A's NR-A-006 sparse-reward bound via the shared gain loop — the battery measures whether the predictor compensates.
B baseline uses affect='none' per NR-B-002 (error-affect rejected); PAD not run as a B arm.
margin_rationale: Absolute margins set from prior lab scale data (not tuned post-hoc): changing_rule/compositional_rule max ~480/episode-battery (K10 learned 368-392); pomaze returns ~-4..+1 (EXP-FP-0006 B arms -3.2..-4.0); delayed_reward/cue_delayed_reward ~0..1.2 (symbolic 0.48). Margins are ~4-12% of typical scale: 20, 20, 0.5, 0.15, 0.15.
metric: Per env, per seed: mean episode return over the env's frozen episode count. Delta_CA(s) = mean_C(s) - mean_A(s); Delta_CB(s) = mean_C(s) - mean_B(s).
null: H0: C does not beat A and B by the margins (C <= A + margin or C <= B + margin on a majority of envs). A negative is a first-class result: the hybrid's added complexity is not justified by measured performance.

overall_verdict.C_BEATS: C_BEATS_A AND C_BEATS_B. Anything else = FAIL (report per-env per-seed breakdown honestly). A 3/5 reading is reported descriptively, not as a pass.

status: PREREGISTERED — frozen before implementation and before any battery run
title: C build-and-beat: hybrid of proven A and B components vs A and B by preregistered margins
win_rule_per_env: C beats X on env E iff seed-mean Delta_CX > margin_E AND Delta_CX(s) > 0 on >= 3/4 seeds.
